name: Conformance: per-tool authorization probe
description: host-services.md §toolHooks (`perToolAuthorization`) — one node, `core.conformance.scoped-tool` (conformance-RESERVED): a host that advertises `toolHooks.perToolAuthorization` maps it to ONE external tool call, of the tool `conformance.scope-probe`, made through the host's ordinary tool-invocation path as the run's principal, with the tool's `requiredScopes` set to `[inputs.requiredScope]` (or `[]` when it is empty or absent). The tool, when invoked, POSTs `{}` to `inputs.url` and returns `{ invoked: true }`. The per-tool authorization check runs before it, as for any tool: a lacked or unevaluable scope MUST NOT invoke it, MUST emit `agent.tool-returned { status: forbidden }`, and fails the node with the refusal — `forbidden` with `details.scope: "tool"`, `toolName` and `requiredScopes` — unchanged. Operator contract: no principal holds `conformance:never-granted`, and evaluating `conformance:unevaluable` errors. See conformance/fixtures.md §`conformance-tool-scope-probe` and v2-tool-authorization-fail-closed.test.ts.

variables.name: requiredScope
variables.description: The one scope the tool requires; empty for none (the positive control).

variables.name: url
variables.description: Where the tool POSTs when it is invoked — the suite's receiver.
